create_EfficientNetEncoder: create an EfficientNetEncoder instance with configurable latent channels and backbone model selection
build_EfficientNetEncoder_s: build an EfficientNetEncoder using efficientnet_v2_s backbone with default pretrained weights
build_EfficientNetEncoder_l: build an EfficientNetEncoder using efficientnet_v2_l backbone with default pretrained weights
run_EfficientNetEncoder_forward: run the EfficientNetEncoder forward pass to encode input images into latent representations
review_EfficientNetEncoder_mapper: review the EfficientNetEncoder mapper module that projects backbone features to latent space
